description: A confirmed review correction must reach every consumer of the same user-date contract while preserving the UTC audit exception and the exact write boundary.
human_review_requirements: radius: Verify the repair follows the common user-date contract across chart, detail and share output, rather than fixing only the named chart occurrence or sweeping unrelated date semantics into the change.

exception: Verify the UTC-only audit contract, naive-input rejection, public signatures and exact days.py write boundary remain intact; a broad all-local-time rewrite does not satisfy this requirement.
